title: Gaza Hospital Struck Despite Ceasefire. In 1993 Rabin and Arafat Shook Hands #shorts
description:
This week officials said an Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Gaza killed at least six people, despite a ceasefire. In September 1993, Israel's Yitzhak Rabin and the PLO's Yasser Arafat shook hands on the White House lawn to launch the Oslo Accords, which promised a path to peace.

comment: Can a ceasefire last without a real peace deal? Oslo 1993, Gaza 2026.
